name: Hegemarch
storyline: The last Hegemarch fell, and the sector went dark. Rival dynasties now compete to rebuild an empire across its worlds and claim the title for themselves.
summary:
Hegemarch is a real-time space strategy roguelite played in the web browser.

Players choose one of several dynasties, colonize planets, manage an economy and command fleets against AI-controlled rival dynasties to take control of a star sector. Each run takes place in a newly generated sector, and a daily run gives all players the same seeded sector. All graphics, sound and music are generated procedurally in code.
